economy.summary: Says Pennsylvania must increase its minimum wage, noting every surrounding state has a higher one, and supports a $15 minimum wage tied to inflation.
economy.short: Supports a $15 minimum wage tied to inflation.

taxes.summary: As a member of the House Appropriations Committee, says she prioritizes the budget process to enact change, and supported increased funding for state agencies that drive affordable housing along with a proposed $1 billion Critical Infrastructure Fund.
taxes.short: Supports budget funding for affordable housing agencies, infrastructure fund.

abortion.summary: Welcomed an April 2026 Commonwealth Court decision overturning Pennsylvania's ban on Medicaid coverage of abortion, saying it marks a step toward ensuring every Pennsylvanian, no matter their income, can make their own reproductive health care decisions; her campaign platform says she will protect reproductive liberty.
abortion.short: Supports Medicaid abortion coverage; pledges to protect reproductive liberty.

education.summary: Says fair funding for public schools has been House Democrats' top priority and that the state must invest $4.5 billion to close the adequacy gap; cites additional state investments in Pittsburgh Public Schools for school safety, mental health, and facilities improvements.
education.short: Supports $4.5 billion investment to close school funding gap.

healthcare.summary: Her campaign platform calls for defending Medicaid so families can get the care they need, and for advancing Black maternal health and reducing preventable death.
healthcare.short: Platform: defend Medicaid; advance Black maternal health.

energy.summary: In a 2026 primary voter guide, said data centers drain water supplies and strain the electrical grid, causing environmental harm through air pollution and noise; she serves on the House Environmental Resources and Energy Committee.
energy.short: Says data centers strain grid, water; cause pollution, noise.

guns.summary: Co-sponsored 2023 legislation to require locking devices and safe storage of firearms when not in use, with penalties; the bill did not pass the House.
guns.short: Co-sponsored firearm safe-storage requirement legislation with penalties.
